sermon.title: Beasts, Saints, and Harvests Part 1
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this message, the seventh lesson in his Revelation study, Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that the beast of Revelation 13 is directly connected to Satan, that the waters it comes from are people, and that the antichrist is defined in Scripture. He says Satan lost power at the cross and now has only limited power with God’s permission, then discusses worship, blasphemy of God’s name, the three and a half years, and persecution of Christians.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: the video begins mid-lesson, with the first words at 0:01. “John chapter 2” (at about 5:33) is how he names the passages on antichrists; the matching words are 1 John 2:18 and 2:22, and the words about those who say Jesus has not come in the flesh are in 2 John 7. “Revelations 123” in the captions is Revelation 12:3. The passages about the Devil’s temptation and about Satan and Job are not named by reference; Luke 4:5–7 and Job 1:12 are shown. “[Unclear]” marks one spot (about 18:59) where the captions were not clear. He names one public figure from the 1980s as an example of an antichrist theory, and later names two national political leaders and says they have blasphemed; he also says Christians in America are “the persecuted group,” makes remarks about homosexuality and about other religions and groups (“the Jesus-only people,” “the Jews,” “all religions lead to the same God”), and cites polls. These are his own opinions and claims, have not been checked by this site, and are kept out of the short answers; the names appear in the transcript only. He reads Scripture aloud with wording that differs from the NKJV text shown. In the caption “the waters where the horse sits” the word was corrected to “whore” (Revelation 17:15 speaks of the harlot). The public figure is named at about 1:39 and the two political leaders at about 15:01.

chunks.section_question: What are the beasts, the saints and the harvests in this lesson? (Revelation 13:1)

Reading Revelation 13:1, he says John saw a beast with seven heads and 10 horns and “the name of blasphemy” on its heads, and that blasphemy “means to speak evil of, speak bad about.”

chunks.section_question: Is the beast connected to Satan? (Revelation 12:3, 13:2)
chunks.short_answer: He says the dragon gave the first beast his power, seat and great authority, and since “the fiery red dragon” of Revelation 12:3 is Satan with seven heads and 10 horns, “this beast is directly connected to who? Satan himself.” He says “we don’t need theories, we need what? Just truth.”
chunks.text: Now, we got to remember that Revelation 12:3 told us the fiery red dragon, which was who? Satan, plainly tells us. There had how many heads? Seven heads and 10 horns. So this beast is directly connected to who? Satan himself. I mean, you know, you don’t have to have some antichrist rising up over in Asia, uh, like Jerry Falwell said in 1900 or so, the late 1800s, 1980s, uh, that some antichrist was born over in Asia, and, and, you know, he’s dead and gone, and so is that theory. We don’t need theories, we need what? Just truth. And if we don’t know it, we just need to say, “We, you know, it’s not been given to us yet.” But we know that this beast is connected with Satan, because it’s the same connection here.

chunks.section_question: Is the beast one person or people? (Revelation 17:15, Daniel 8:20)
chunks.short_answer: Reading Revelation 17:15, he says the waters the beast comes up out of are “multitudes, nations, and tongues,” so “it’s people.” He says a kingdom is the people in it, not just a king: “a king can be bad, or a king can be good, the people can be good with a bad king,” so “the key is the people here.”
chunks.text:
Now, we also know that the waters, this beast comes up out of the waters, out of the seas, and we know that the waters in Revelation 17:15, the waters where the whore sits, we’ll be getting into her next week, are multitudes, nations, and tongues. Okay, the Bible tells us what the waters are. Right. Hallelujah. So it’s people. This thing is going to be in people. A nation is nothing more than people with a certain culture and certain laws and a certain government that they abide by. It’s always people. So it’s people that this beast comes through, works through, and so forth.

In Daniel chapter 8:20 and also Daniel chapter 7, we all know this theory, we hear it all the time, of the beast being a king. But if you read, the ram with two horns are the kings of Media and Persia, the male goat is the what? Is the what? Kingdom. Who lives in a kingdom? Who lives in a kingdom? People. So it doesn’t have to be the king. In fact, in the Bible it says that Jotham was a good man, but the people did corruptly, and then it turns around and says Manasseh seduced the people of God to do corruptly. So a king can be bad, or a king can be good, the people can be good with a bad king, or the people can be what? Yeah, vice versa. The key is the people here. Amen.

chunks.section_question: What are the three kingdoms, and how does the Bible define the antichrist?
chunks.short_answer: He says there are three kingdoms: God’s, man’s, and “the kingdom of darkness, kingdom of sin, Satan,” and each is made of people acting out their ruler. He says the beast “is never called the antichrist in scripture,” and that the antichrists are “those who say Jesus has not come in the flesh” and people “who do not believe in the Father and the Son.”
chunks.text:
We know that there are three kingdoms in the Bible: the kingdom of God, the spiritual kingdom; the kingdom of man, like the United States, natural area; and the kingdom of darkness, kingdom of sin, Satan. See, we know that. And so the kingdom of Satan, connecting with people who do wrong, are a kingdom of people that are acting out the ruler of that kingdom, Satan. The kingdom of light, the kingdom of righteousness, the kingdom of God, are people who are acting out the king of that kingdom, and that is righteousness. Amen. Nothing confusing about that at all, is there? No. See, there’s things that we know. We know the beast, nor the son of perdition, is never called the antichrist in scripture. Never. They have to bring it together.

The Bible never says, in fact it says the antichrist are those who say Jesus has not come in the flesh. Plainly tells us who the antichrist are. It defines the antichrist, and he says, John, in John chapter 2, he says there are how many? Many antichrists. And then again in John chapter 2, it says that the antichrists are people who do not believe in the Father and the Son. Whoo. And so the Jesus-only people have a problem here. The Jews have a problem here. You got to believe in God and what? Jesus Christ, his Son, who came, and that was God, by the way, and died for the sins of the world. See, the Bible tells, see, we know these things. They, this is not fantasy, we know this stuff, if you read your Bible. This is just common sense, it’s just simple doctrine. How many are learning something already? I’m glad. The rest of you are that smart. Ah.

chunks.section_question: Can Satan touch us without God’s permission? (Luke 4:5–6, Job)
chunks.short_answer: He says the Devil showed Jesus all the kingdoms and God has given Satan “a limited power,” and that he has power over the nations only “if he gets permission” from Jesus Christ, as with Job. He says “aren’t you glad that Satan can’t touch you unless God gives him permission,” and that God knows “you’re able to handle it.”
chunks.text:
Now, the Devil, taking Jesus up into a high mountain, showed Jesus all the kingdoms in the world in a moment of time, a twinkling of an eye. The Devil said to him, “All this power I give you, and the glory of them, for that is delivered unto me, and to whomsoever will I give it.” And so God has given Satan a limited power, and he does have power over the nations if he gets permission from who? Jesus Christ himself. In Job, didn’t he have to get permission from God to touch Job? Yes. Hallelujah. See, he created the waster to destroy. God can’t go around destroying people. See, God is good. God can’t lie. There’s things that God can’t do. People say, “Well, if he’s God, he can do anything.” No, there’s things he can’t do. He can’t lie, he can’t sin, and he can’t harm people. So what did he do? He created Satan to do this, and Satan can only do it with whose permission?

Yeah. Jesus is head over what? The principalities and powers of darkness, the head of the church, the head of the nations, isn’t that right? And the head of his kingdom. Does this make sense to you? It makes a lot of sense. Aren’t you glad that Satan can’t touch you unless God gives him permission? And if God gives him permission, aren’t you glad that the Bible says he knows you’re able to handle it? Oh man, that was a big relief back there when I was a young Christian. Hallelujah. Praise God.

chunks.section_question: What does it mean to worship the dragon and the beast? (Revelation 13:4)
chunks.short_answer: He says worship “means giving homage to someone, respecting someone, adoring someone,” so when we follow Jesus we are worshiping him, and “worship just isn’t lifting your hands and raising your voice.” He says the beast causes the world to worship the dragon and the beast, and “you follow one, you’re following the other.” He says we are the temple of God, built of living stones.
chunks.text:
Now, we read on there in Revelation that this beast causes all the world to worship the dragon and worship the beast. Now, worship means giving homage to someone, respecting someone, adoring someone, and see, when we follow someone’s footsteps, we are worshiping them. We’re respecting them, we’re giving homage to them. So when we, what, follow Jesus, we are worshiping him. Worship just isn’t lifting your hands and raising your voice. The Bible says, “Worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness,” right living. You say, “Which is greater, lifting your hands in the sacrifice of praise or everyday life living for him?” Yeah. Which one are the people out there going to see? The everyday life. See, that’s worship.

Hallelujah. And he causes the whole world to worship the dragon and the beast. You see, they, you notice how they’re connected? You follow one, you’re following the other. Now, this beast blasphemed God, speaks evil of God, and, uh, blasphemes God’s name, Jesus’s name, and blasphemes his temple. What is the temple of God? We learned that last week. We are. See, God doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands. He don’t need a temple built over there in Jerusalem. He is building a human temple, living stones, said Peter. Said, hallelujah, we are. See, the Spirit of God dwells in us, we’re the temple of God.

chunks.section_question: What does it mean that the beast blasphemes God’s name? (Revelation 13:6, John 1:1)
chunks.short_answer: He says the beast blasphemes the church and the name of God, which he says is “the Lord Jesus Christ of Nazareth.” He says some national leaders say “God” and not “Jesus” because “the universal God is what’s being promoted,” and when you won’t say Jesus “you are blaspheming the name of God.” He says “Jesus said he was God,” and cites John 1:1.
chunks.text:
So he blasphemes the church. See, he blasphemes the name of God. What is the name of God? The Lord Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Are you there? Listen, Obama and Bush, both as leaders, has blasphemed the church, blasphemed the scriptures, blasphemed Jesus. Neither one of them will use the name of Jesus. They use God. Why? Because the universal God is what’s being promoted by these people, that all religions lead to the same God. That’s why they won’t say Jesus. And when you won’t say Jesus, you are blaspheming the name of God. Which name is a name above all names, is it God or Jesus? Yes. Why? It specifically says who God is and who God was when he dwelt among us. And that’s why these people want to bring down the name of Jesus.

The name of Jesus either makes you come to him or breaks you, and you want to run from him. God, no problem. I can make God anything I want to be. You can’t make Jesus anything. Or they can. They say he’s a human being, they say he’s a prophet, but he, no, Jesus said he was God. The scriptures, John 1:1, says he’s God. Jesus is who God... God himself came down in human flesh, became one of us, and died for us, and we called his name Jesus of Nazareth, not Jesus of Mexico City. All right, let’s get that straight. Amen. Now, and he made him Lord and Christ, isn’t that right? He is all controlling, and he is the Messiah. See, we know these things.

paragraphs.text: So he blasphemes the church. See, he blasphemes the name of God. What is the name of God? The Lord Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Are you there? Listen, Obama and Bush, both as leaders, has blasphemed the church, blasphemed the scriptures, blasphemed Jesus. Neither one of them will use the name of Jesus. They use God. Why? Because the universal God is what’s being promoted by these people, that all religions lead to the same God. That’s why they won’t say Jesus. And when you won’t say Jesus, you are blaspheming the name of God. Which name is a name above all names, is it God or Jesus? Yes. Why? It specifically says who God is and who God was when he dwelt among us. And that’s why these people want to bring down the name of Jesus.

“Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ.”

chunks.section_question: Is the three and a half years in Revelation a literal period? (Revelation 13:5)
chunks.short_answer: He says the beast’s power is in his speech “for three and a half years,” but that he has already shown that focus is “shaky,” with “four times 3 and 1/2 years, that’s 14 years.” He says singling things down to three-and-a-half-year periods and a seven-year tribulation gives “real problems from the scriptures.”
chunks.text: Now, his power is in his speech, and he does this for three and a half years. Okay, it says three and a half years. A lot of focus is on this three and a half years, and I tell you, I’ve already showed you where that is shaky. I’ve already showed you there is four times 3 and 1/2 years, that’s 14 years. Now today you’re going to see another problem of 3 and 1/2 years. When you try to single things down into three and 1/2 year periods and a seven-year period of tribulation and all the rest, you got some real problems from the scriptures, real problems. All right, for instance, let me ask you, was the early church blasphemed by the Roman Empire and the citizens of the Roman Empire? Yes, absolutely. Did they persecute the church? Absolutely.

chunks.section_question: Has the church been persecuted since the beginning?
chunks.short_answer: He says the early church was blasphemed and persecuted by the Roman Empire, and that Christians have been persecuted “from the early church to the present time,” so “you’re worried about a little three-and-a-half-year period?” He says Satan “comes to rob, steal, kill, and what? Destroy,” and that Christians through the ages “stayed with Jesus.”
chunks.text:
Were the Christians persecuted from the early church to the present time? Yes. Were they blasphemed? Were they talked about? Yes. And you’re worried about a little three-and-a-half-year period? This has been going on since Jesus ascended. When we showed you the millions of Christians who had lost their life throughout the ages of persecution, and not just Christians, you can just be of a different color, a different race, a different culture, and another culture will persecute you, kill you, and mistreat you. This stuff has been going on for ages. Why? Because this beast, Satan, working in people, and the Satan is called a thief, he comes to rob, steal, kill, and what? Destroy. And when people follow him, yeah, they have cultural problems, race problems, and all the rest. Why? Because that’s what Satan does, he’s out to destroy.

See, they didn’t worship the Satan, they didn’t worship evil, they didn’t go that route, whether it was a government, whether it was a people, whether it was a group, they stayed with Jesus. chunks.section_question: Who does he say is being persecuted today? (Revelation 13:7, Daniel 7:21)
chunks.short_answer: Reading that the beast “makes war and overcomes the saints,” he says Daniel spoke of another beast that overcame the saints, and that leaders persecuted Jesus and his church up to now. He says “Christians in America right now are the persecuted group,” gives examples of what he says Christians are not allowed to say or preach, and says “these theory people” have our eyes on a seven-year period instead. These are his views.
chunks.text:
This beast makes war and overcomes the saints, and he has power over the nations. He overcomes the saints for three and a half years. Daniel talked about another beast that overcame the saints for a period of time. I submit to you that even while Jesus was here, government leaders, religious leaders, and people that identified with him persecuted Jesus, they killed Jesus, they persecuted his church, they killed people in the church up to this present time. But you see, these theory people got us thinking about a 7-year period up there, and we’re missing what is happening in our own nation. Christians in America right now are the persecuted group. It’s not the blacks, it’s not the Mexicans, it’s the Christians. You can’t call a homosexual a homosexual, you can’t call them a queer.

The Bible calls him a homosexual, the, the Bible calls him a sodomite. There’s a lot of things you can’t do. You can’t use the name of Jesus, you can’t preach, you know, sexual immorality and so forth, and they say it’s a hate crime, a hate crime, you understand? And see, we got our eyes on these stupid theories and we don’t see what’s happening in our own generation. Hallelujah. That was a good, that was good. And see, that’s one of Satan’s gimmicks: if he can get our eyes on something else and not really what’s happening around us and who we are, we’re going to find out again who we are during this time, and we are a powerful people.

chunks.section_question: Why does he say Christians have lost the power of the word?
chunks.short_answer: He says Christians “have never” been “in total control” in 2,000 years and have always been subservient to governments that limit them, such as China. He says Christians in this country are “in dreamland” and “don’t see the decay around us,” and that “we have lost the power of the word to stand up for truth.” He cites polls on views of homosexuality as support. These are his views.
chunks.text:
I submit to you, Christians have never, throughout the history, these last 2,000 years, been in total control. We’ve always been subservient to some government that wants to limit us. Could that be an amen? China limits him so bad, you can’t even preach over there, people get arrested and they get killed. It’s been going on for 2,000 years. Am I right? When you look at it right, you see it right.

And we have slowly, in the last 40 years, 50 years, lost this nation. It started in the ‘60s, and Christians are so in dreamland, they don’t see the decay around us. And in fact, many Christians today believe there is no hell, there is no lake of fire, that Jesus was not born of a virgin. It’s growing every time. In the ‘70s, when the homosexuals came out, 90% of the people said that was wrong. Now it’s less than 50% of Americans are saying that homosexuality is wrong. Why? The Christians have let the word of God decay to such a place, and them undermine the word of God, say it’s just a book of fables, it’s just a book of faith, you know, it’s got weird things in it. They’re, they’re lying. And Christians are so caught up in this nonsense of the second coming, and, and, you know, helping the poor and helping the sick, that we have lost the power of the word to stand up for truth. We’re accepting lies. Could that be true? According to the polls, that is true.

faqs.question: What does he say blasphemy means?
faqs.answer: He says “blasphemy means to speak evil of, speak bad about.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. And I saw a beast rising up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his horns ten crowns, and on his heads a blasphemous name.

faqs.question: Does he say an antichrist has to rise up somewhere?
faqs.answer: He says “you don’t have to have some antichrist rising up over in Asia” and that “we don’t need theories, we need what? Just truth.” He says if we don’t know something, “it’s not been given to us yet.”

faqs.question: What does he say the waters in Revelation 17:15 are?
faqs.answer: He says the Bible tells us the waters are “multitudes, nations, and tongues,” so “it’s people,” and that “a nation is nothing more than people with a certain culture and certain laws and a certain government.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then he said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the harlot sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and tongues.

faqs.question: Does he say the beast has to be a king?
faqs.answer: He says no: “it doesn’t have to be the king.” He points to Daniel’s ram and goat as kingdoms, and asks “who lives in a kingdom? People.” He says “the key is the people here.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: The ram which you saw, having the two horns—they are the kings of Media and Persia.

faqs.question: What are the three kingdoms he describes?
faqs.answer: He names “the kingdom of God, the spiritual kingdom,” “the kingdom of man, like the United States,” and “the kingdom of darkness, kingdom of sin, Satan.”

faqs.question: How does he say Scripture defines the antichrist?
faqs.answer: He says the Bible “defines the antichrist” as “those who say Jesus has not come in the flesh,” and that there are “many antichrists.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: For many deceivers have gone out into the world who do not confess Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
Little children, it is the last hour; and as you have heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have come, by which we know that it is the last hour.

faqs.question: What does he say happened to Satan’s power when Jesus died?
faqs.answer: He says when Jesus died on the cross “he is bringing Satan down, destroying his power, destroying the authority that he had,” and that Hebrews 2:14 says Jesus’ death destroyed the one who had the power of death.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Inasmuch then as the children have partaken of flesh and blood, He Himself likewise shared in the same, that through death He might destroy him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

faqs.question: Does he say Satan has power today?
faqs.answer: He says “the power was taken, and then limited power was given,” and “Satan has been given power again to seduce people, deceive people, and war with the saints.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the sons of disobedience,

faqs.question: Can Satan do whatever he wants, according to him?
faqs.answer: He says no: God has given Satan “a limited power,” and “aren’t you glad that Satan can’t touch you unless God gives him permission?”

scriptures.text_nkjv: And the LORD said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power; only do not lay a hand on his person.” So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD.

faqs.question: What does he say worship means?
faqs.answer: He says worship “means giving homage to someone, respecting someone, adoring someone,” and “worship just isn’t lifting your hands and raising your voice.” He cites “worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness, right living.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Give unto the LORD the glory due to His name; Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

faqs.question: What does he say the temple of God is?
faqs.answer: He says “God doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands” and “he don’t need a temple built over there in Jerusalem.” He says “the Spirit of God dwells in us, we’re the temple of God.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: God, who made the world and everything in it, since He is Lord of heaven and earth, does not dwell in temples made with hands.
you also, as living stones, are being built up a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

faqs.question: What does he say about the name of Jesus?
faqs.answer: He says “the name of Jesus either makes you come to him or breaks you,” and that Jesus “said he was God.” He says the scriptures, John 1:1, say “he’s God.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

faqs.question: How long does he say persecution of Christians has been going on?
faqs.answer: He says “this has been going on since Jesus ascended,” and that people of a different color, race or culture can also be persecuted by another culture.

faqs.question: How does he say early Christians responded to persecution?
faqs.answer: He says “the early church did not bow and give in,” “they didn’t worship the Satan, they didn’t worship evil,” and “they stayed with Jesus.”

faqs.question: Does he say Christians have ever been in total control?
faqs.answer: He says no: “Christians have never, throughout the history, these last 2,000 years, been in total control,” and have “always been subservient to some government that wants to limit us.”
